Technology help for small organizations.

FIDDLE,GREEN supports small businesses, nonprofits, startups, and public agencies, taking on the big challenges that hold organizations back. We built the practice around work at this scale — so you get experienced experts, real attention, and solid guidance.

Why FIDDLE,GREEN?

You are the destination, not a stepping stone. We are not building a portfolio on small clients so we can go chase bigger ones — this is the work we want, and it is why the attention is real.

We know the value of a dollar, and how to stretch it. Our team has worked in some of the lowest-resource settings in the world and with bootstrapped nonprofits running on fumes. We advocate for you so vendors treat you like their biggest customer. When the job is done, we hand you the keys: documentation and training so your team can run it without us.

Whatever the size of the job, you get the same people and the same straight answers. The first conversation is free and commits you to nothing.
